callings.title: Ngaahi Uiuiʻi
callings.description: Muimui fokotu'u → fakalahi → fakatolonga → fokotu'u mavahe 'a e siakale 'o e mo'ui.

callings.addCallingDescription: Fili mei he ngaahi uiuiʻi angamaheni pe lomiʻi ha hingoa uiuiʻi angamaheni. Fakaʻaongaʻi pē ʻa e Vahevahé ki he ngaahi fatongia ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu ke fokotuʻu, poupouʻi, pe vahevahe ʻa e founga ngāué.
callings.proposedDescription: Ko e ngaahi uiuiʻi kuo ʻosi fokotuʻu ka ʻoku teʻeki ke fakaloloa.

callings.extendedDescription: Ko e ngaahi uiuiʻi kuo fakaloloá — ʻe ʻasi ia ʻi he pisinisi fakauooti ʻo e houalotu sākalamēnití ki hono poupouʻí.
